verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has the building blocks. It auto-matches invoice payments, imports bank feeds, and offers reconciliation and discrepancy reports. Intuit Intelligence chat can 'help resolve anomalies', and an official MCP server gives an agent CRUD access to 29 entity types and 11 financial reports. However, nothing in the evidence shows an agent running the reconciliation workflow itself end-to-end and handing off a close package for review; the agent would have to assemble this from generic API tools and in-app features. Missing for 10: an agent-accessible reconciliation workflow (matching and statement reconcile via the MCP server or API), agent-driven exception flagging tied to reconciliation, a month-end close preparation or review handoff, and hands-on corroboration.
